protocol: Frozen existing OOF predictions rescored on640common pairs with correctedv32 labels. New642row global ranking refit uses same outer family membership; two added rows assigned by existing family, train-only inner selection. Premium assessor not refitted: full-config six-case diagnostics are seen-data checks, not heldout validation. Exact equality never approximated by meaningfulness band.

prediction.units: pair-comparison score, not a standalone price

target.basis: Explicit voice clarification; raw interpretation and tentative qualification retained in evidence.
